description: Analytical diagonal LQR trajectories with C=I/C!=I, m!=p, full-state feedback and saturation on/off.

provenance.oracle: Exact CARE P=I,K=I,Q=diag(3,5); closed-form piecewise exponential trajectories (no numerical simulator)
provenance.hardware: IEEE-754 float64 CPU; BLAS last-bit variation permitted by tolerances
provenance.scope: independent_cpython_oracle_only; no Wasm or official PathView acceptance

equations.controller: u_raw=N*r-K*x; u=clip(u_raw,u_min,u_max) only when saturation enabled
equations.reference: r has p_ref columns; N is m by p_ref; K reads full state x, never y
equations.saturation_solution: constant saturated u until x=v-u_sat; then continuous linear solution; switch times stored
